about.title: About SmartIoTVN
about.subtitle: A Vietnamese platform on a mission to make IoT engineering practical, affordable and fun.
about.missionText: SmartIoTVN exists to close the gap between theory and practice. We build courses around real hardware, sell the exact boards we teach with, and publish every project so you can rebuild it yourself.
about.value1Text: Every concept is taught on real hardware, never slideware.
about.value2Text: Content evolves with feedback from thousands of Vietnamese makers.
about.value3Text: We test every board and sensor in our own lab before listing it.
about.contactDesc: Questions about courses, orders or partnerships? Reach out anytime.
